events.title: Demo updated for Next Fest
events.summary: The Plasma Sky demo has been updated for Next Fest week. Most of what changed came straight out of the feedback thread, so thank you for posting. Here's the list!CONTROLSRESTART is on the pause menu now, right above RESUME. On a controller, tap SELECT (the View button on Steam Deck) twice to restart a run on the spot.D-pad and keyboard movement starts at full speed on the first frame. events.title: Plasma Sky returns!
events.summary: Hi all!I'm so stoked to revive and upgrade Plasma Sky so that more people can play it.
